Late-horizon discipline: repeatedly reseeds new chains from the current best state and saves best from each chain, preserving progress while exploring.

reasoning: Across a very long optimization arc the agent continuously tracked S3/NC against the 0.32/0.55/0.30 thresholds, preserved best-so-far alignments per deliverable while exploring, and repeatedly detected plateaus (killing stalled chains, switching algorithms, reseeding from the best state) — squarely matching the level-8 anchor and reaching into level-10 territory with its 'preserve best while exploring, reseed from best' discipline. It stops short of a perfect 10 because the log shows repeated point-in-time status polling rather than explicit numeric score-progression logging, and some redundant wait/poll cycles. I place it at 9 with medium confidence given the evidence is action titles rather than full observation text.
